review_kind: Independent read-only semantic attribution of already-recorded native failures; no program execution
method: Manually compare each frozen mutation edit, intended test method, source assertion and surrounding fixture with native raw AssertionError details. AST parsing and literal evaluation inspect data only. The existing structural audit supplies direct assertion frame cross-links; its semantic conclusions are not assumed.

coverage_qualifications.note: StaleTmp exception witness is a relevant consequence of tmp=p, not independent proof of atomic or crash-durable writes.
Observed assertion is unreadable power-supply type fallback at line 373, not the later unsupported USB string fixture.

Observed failures compare exact constants against a historical Git oracle; the recorded numeric assertion demonstrates the oracle succeeded, and no historical candidate source was read in this review.
The shared failing case carries a Y03 label but lacks the full standalone acceptance line required by N02; it is relevant to both edits.
Observed tuple mismatch is cgroup_ns_initial metadata only; effective_limit and headroom remain None.
Native platform/library reads initialize fixtures, but the intended failing assertions inspect explicitly overwritten unreadable values or explicit incomplete mapped-object text.
Intended assertions exist but native ERROR status prohibits kill credit regardless of those assertion failures.
